DXC Technology Co is a public company with SEC CIK 0001688568, ticker DXC, and headquarters in Ashburn, Virginia. Its website, dexus.com, presents Dexus, which describes itself as an Australasian infrastructure and real estate funds and assets business with four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development. The site's disclaimer identifies the business as Dexus (ASX: DXS). The website text does not mention DXC Technology Co.

The website content does not describe any AI products. The available record lists no products and no MCP servers for DXC Technology Co, so no AI product position can be reported from these materials.

The SEC profile lists the company as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001688568, ticker DXC, and headquarters in Ashburn, Virginia. The record includes a Virginia law exposure count of 152 and no cases.
